question: ( (sin theta - 2 sin³ theta)/(2 cos³ theta - cos theta) )³ (1)/(tan theta) - sec² theta = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put θ = 30° in the given expression to solve quickly.

⇒ [(1/2 − 2 × 1/8) / (2 × 3√3/8 − √3/2)]³ × (1 / tan 30°) − sec² 30°

⇒ [(1/4) / (√3/4)]³ × √3 − (2/√3)²

⇒ (1/√3)³ × √3 − 4/3

⇒ (1 / 3√3) × √3 − 4/3 = 1/3 − 4/3 = −1

**∴ The correct answer is -1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: [(sin θ − 2 sin³ θ) / (2 cos³ θ − cos θ)]³ × (1 / tan θ) − sec² θ

**Formula Used:**

cos 2θ = 1 − 2 sin² θ = 2 cos² θ − 1

sec² θ − tan² θ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ Take out sin θ common from the numerator and cos θ common from the denominator.

⇒ [{sin θ (1 − 2 sin² θ)} / {cos θ (2 cos² θ − 1)}]³ × (1 / tan θ) − sec² θ

⇒ [{sin θ × cos 2θ} / {cos θ × cos 2θ}]³ × (1 / tan θ) − sec² θ

⇒ (sin θ / cos θ)³ × (1 / tan θ) − sec² θ

⇒ (tan θ)³ × (1 / tan θ) − sec² θ

⇒ tan² θ − sec² θ

⇒ −(sec² θ − tan² θ)

⇒ −1

**∴ The correct answer is -1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Double Angle Formulas

sin 2θ = 2 sin θ cos θ
cos 2θ = cos² θ − sin² θ = 2 cos² θ − 1 = 1 − 2 sin² θ

Pythagorean Identities

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1
1 + tan² θ = sec² θ ⇒ sec² θ − tan² θ = 1
1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ ⇒ cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1

Reciprocal Identities

sec θ = 1 / cos θ
cosec θ = 1 / sin θ
cot θ = 1 / tan θ
</p
